changes.comment: Several stores in one page work through the extension's bridge. Each `postMessage` socket stamps its frames with its own `connection` id, accepts only frames to the page that carry its id (or none), and posts a `closed` notice when it closes; `BridgeMessage` gains the optional `connection` and `closed` fields. Before, every store on a page reached the panel as one connection: only the first store registered, and a command for one store, time travel included, was applied by all of them.
